task.title: Whole-sentence argument errors across the CLI
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M42). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

`workbook relic update` explains an unknown option or a missing value in a sentence. Every other command prints a generic "invalid ... arguments" line.

## Wanted

Give every command the same whole-sentence argument errors.

## Done when

- An unknown option or a missing value is named in the error of every command.
- Exit codes do not change.
